data.title: Cook Protocol Launches $SAMANT Meme Token Paired With Tokenized Samsung Electronics Shares
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Cook Protocol recently launched $SAMANT, a meme token paired with tokenized Samsung Electronics shares (SAMSUNGs). Inspired by South Korea’s retail-investor “ant” culture, the token is available for trading in Cook’s Uniswap v4 pool and has a fixed supply of 1 billion.

Each buy or sell in the pool incurs a fee of 2% in SAMSUNGs. The fee allocation is 30% to liquidity providers, 10% to Cook platform fees, 30% to a holder dividend pool, 20% to token buybacks and 10% to project development. Eligible holders can receive proportional dividends without staking, and anyone may trigger a buyback when specified conditions are met.

Cook Protocol says $SAMANT is a meme token and does not grant holders shareholder rights in Samsung Electronics. It also cautions that the token’s price is highly volatile.

data.title: Elon Musk Expects Optimus to Handle Household Chores Within 12–18 Months
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing STAR Market Daily, Elon Musk said in a video interview that he expects the Optimus robot to handle household tasks within 12–18 months, including taking out the trash, washing dishes, and putting them away in cabinets.

data.title: Aelf Says Public Full-Node Service and Aelfscan Faced Thousands of Attacks
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing aelf, the network detected thousands of malicious attacks targeting its public full-node service and Aelfscan over the past two days. Functions dependent on the services have been temporarily suspended while the team works to restore them. The aelf blockchain itself was unaffected and continues producing blocks normally.

data.title: U.S. Gasoline Nears $3.50, Potentially Good News for U.S. President Donald Trump
data.description: According to Jin10, the American Automobile Association (AAA) puts the U.S. average retail gasoline price at about $3.72 per gallon, an eight-month low and 15% below its most recent peak in September. Prices are expected to fall further before the Thanksgiving holiday. The decline reflects a substantial recovery in Middle Eastern crude flows and increased gasoline supply as a byproduct of diesel production, as well as the end of the Northern Hemisphere summer travel season, a seasonal drop in gasoline demand, and rapid growth in electric-vehicle sales. Gasoline nearing the $3.50 threshold is another positive for U.S. President Donald Trump: researchers found that when prices fall below that level, news coverage of gasoline declines sharply and it gradually fades from public discussion.

data.title: California Faces $2 Billion Budget Gap Despite Higher-Than-Expected Tax Revenue
data.description: California is projected to run a $2 billion deficit in the next fiscal year even as tax revenue exceeds expectations, according to a forecast from the Legislative Analyst’s Office released Wednesday. Bloomberg reported.

data.title: My Wallet Launches 1:1 Cross-Chain Swaps After No. 1 WalletConnect WalletGuide Listing
data.description: My Wallet has launched 1:1 swaps for USDT, USDC, USDe and USDS across eligible supported blockchains, letting users change tokens or networks in one in-app flow with the destination amount fixed before confirmation. The wallet serves more than 10 million users and is listed first in WalletConnect’s WalletGuide, is WalletConnect Certified and connects to more than 80,000 compatible apps, according to BeInCrypto. Powered by LayerZero, NEAR Intents and other bridges, the swaps are available for routes above $30 with no exchange-rate spread, slippage or wallet swap commission; applicable network fees are charged separately, and other routes may have different rates and fees. My Wallet also supports native Bitcoin and gasless transfers on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and Optimism, in addition to existing gasless support on Solana and TON.

data.title: Variational’s $1.5 Billion Valuation Implies About $47 per Airdrop Point
data.description: Variational raised $110 million in a Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation ahead of a planned airdrop of 32% of its VAR supply. The valuation implies a $480 million airdrop pool, or about $47 per point based on at least 10.2 million points after the November 13 distribution, according to BeInCrypto. The estimate is conditional: Variational has not said whether the valuation applies to the token, and the implied value would decline as more points are issued. The points are weekly rewards for trading on the Omni platform; the program began with 3 million retroactive points and issues 150,000 per week until launch. The airdrop is scheduled to be fully unlocked at launch, while 50% of supply is allocated to the team and investors, locked for 12 months, and 18% to a foundation reserve. Bain Capital Crypto led the round, with Dragonfly, HSG, Peak XV, 50T Funds and others participating. Variational said the capital will lift Omni’s open-interest caps and enable hundreds of new stock, index, commodity and FX listings. A precedent is rival Lighter, which raised $68 million at a valuation Fortune reported at around $1.5 billion in November 2025; its founder said the deal included equity and token warrants. Seven weeks later, Lighter launched LIT and airdropped 25% of its supply. Variational’s token launch is due by year-end.

data.title: Goldman Sachs Strategists: Economic Growth Nears Peak, Favor Stocks and Bonds
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Goldman Sachs strategists favor stocks and government bonds, citing cooling inflation and resilient economic growth, while recommending that investors reduce corporate credit holdings.

The strategy team led by Christian Mueller-Glissmann is overweight stocks, favoring U.S. and Japanese equities while underweighting European equities. It forecasts an 8,700-point 12-month target for the S&P 500, 19% above its current level.

The team is also overweight government bonds, saying falling inflation will push yields lower. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield was 5.11% when the report was published, and the team forecasts it will fall to 4.65% in 12 months.

The team sees investment opportunities shifting from AI infrastructure providers to companies applying AI and gaining efficiency benefits. It is underweight corporate credit, citing narrow credit spreads and rising corporate financing, and says equities offer better value.

data.title: Norinchukin Bank Reports Early Completion of Annual Profit Target as Turnaround Advances
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Norinchukin Bank said its first-half profit had exceeded its full-year expectations, marking further progress in its turnaround plan. For the six months ended September 30, net profit rose 92% year over year to 162.7 billion yen, equivalent to $10 billion. At a Thursday results briefing, the bank said the figure was already above its full-year profit guidance range of 500 billion to 1 trillion yen.

The bank, one of Japan’s largest institutional investors, manages an investment portfolio of about 43.5 trillion yen. It recorded a loss of 1.8 trillion yen in the fiscal year ended March 2025 after misjudging U.S. Treasury and other overseas bond markets, and has since been adjusting its asset mix.

Norinchukin said it would not raise its earnings outlook for now because it is continuing to rebalance its portfolio to improve long-term profitability. President Taro Hayashi cited market volatility risks and said the bank could raise its target later.

The bank plans to diversify investments into areas such as corporate bonds and equities to strengthen its ability to withstand financial-market shocks. When central banks worldwide began raising rates to combat pandemic-related inflation, the market value of Norinchukin’s overseas bond holdings fell sharply and its funding costs rose.

At the end of September, unrealized losses on its bond holdings stood at 2.1 trillion yen, up from 1.2 trillion yen three months earlier.

data.title: Xi Jinping: Nuclear War Cannot Be Won or Fought
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. President Donald Trump in Shenzhen on November 19. Xi said nuclear war cannot be won or fought, and called for every effort to prevent it, compliance with the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons, and the preservation of global strategic stability.

data.title: European TTF Natural Gas Rebounds on Cold Weather Outlook and Low Inventories
data.description: According to Jin10, European natural gas prices rebounded in early trading after falling in the previous session. Benchmark Dutch TTF natural gas futures rose 3.7% today to 83.80 euros per megawatt-hour. Analysts at Australia and New Zealand Banking Group said recent price declines were mainly driven by increased U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports and weaker demand from some major Asian importers, allowing more LNG cargoes to be redirected to Europe. Weather forecasts show temperatures are expected to fall, which could increase heating demand and put more pressure on gas supplies. Meanwhile, European gas storage remains relatively low, with inventories 69.9% full, compared with about 81.9% at the same time last year. This leaves the European gas market more vulnerable to supply tightness as winter demand rises.

data.title: 1inch Team Investment Fund Transfers 8,978 ETH, Reports $8.88 Million Unrealized Loss

data.title: Survey: 63% of Institutional Investors Say SEC Registration Could Bring Tokenized Assets Within Investment Mandates
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, a survey commissioned by ST0x and conducted by PureProfile in August 2026 found that 63% of 200 institutional investors and wealth management professionals said SEC registration could make tokenized assets eligible under their investment mandates. Another 48% said licensing the trading venue for an asset could help it meet those mandates.

Respondents represented investment managers, pension funds, insurers, family offices, banks, custodians and financial market infrastructure firms across North America, the UK, continental Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Asked what could increase trading volumes in tokenized securities, 29% cited automated corporate actions, 27% regulated custody and independent verification, and 19% legally enforceable rights to the underlying securities. Lower trading costs were cited by 3%.

data.title: Multiple U.S. Banks Hold Customers Liable for AI Agents’ Account Activity
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing TechCrunch, Citibank updated its online user agreement this week to say customers who authorize third-party AI agents to access their accounts are responsible for activity carried out by those agents. Customers are also liable for actions hackers take through their accounts if an AI tool exposes their credentials or is compromised. A Citibank spokesperson said the update clarifies the risks of sharing banking credentials or authorizing third-party tools to access accounts.

JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America announced similar policies last month, and PNC Bank revised its terms on November 18. Citizens Bank also emailed customers this week saying they are responsible for actions taken by AI assistants. Citibank’s agreement says customers do not assume additional liability when using the bank’s own AI agents.

data.title: Kernow Asset Management Bets on Beauty Tech Group’s Anti-Aging Demand
data.description: According to CNBC, Kernow Asset Management Chief Investment Officer Alyx Wood presented the hedge fund’s investment case for The Beauty Tech Group, a U.K.-listed maker of at-home beauty devices, at this year’s Sohn London investment conference. Wood sees the company as a way to invest in a broader shift toward beauty treatments that were once limited to clinics becoming smaller, cheaper and available for home use. He considers the company undervalued and sees substantial growth potential. The Beauty Tech Group reported pretax profit of £17.5 million in the first half of this year, more than triple the £5 million reported a year earlier. Wood’s valuation model put the shares at £15 ($19.70), compared with about £5 at the time of his presentation. Founded in 2009, the company went public in 2025, raising £29 million ($38.1 million). Its products include CurrentBody Skin, ZIIP Beauty and Tria Laser. Wood identified an upcoming dividend and broader eligibility for funds as potential catalysts, and said possible inclusion in the FTSE 250 was not far away.

data.title: China and U.S. Agree to Develop Plan for Constructive, Strategically Stable Relations
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Chinese President Xi Jinping met U.S. President Donald Trump in Shenzhen on November 19. The two sides agreed to develop an action plan for constructive, strategically stable relations, implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state, and build China-U.S. relations based on respect, fairness, and equality.

data.title: China Delays Soybean Imports at Ports as Domestic Stockpiles Build
data.description: According to Bloomberg, China is delaying the entry of soybean imports at some ports as weak demand from its vast livestock sector leaves domestic stockpiles overflowing.
